items.text: Genie Code CLI is now generally available and managed the same way as Genie Code in the workspace. Admins manage one Genie Code budget across the CLI and the workspace, and users can apply their free monthly Genie usage in the CLI. See Genie Code CLI.

items.title: Share Unity Catalog agent skills with OpenSharing and Azure Databricks Marketplace (Beta)
items.text: Providers can add Unity Catalog agent skills to OpenSharing shares and Azure Databricks Marketplace listings. Databricks-to-Databricks recipients get read-only access to each shared skill in the catalog they create from the share, and changes that the provider makes reach recipients asynchronously. See Add agent skills to a share and Create a Marketplace listing.

items.title: Databricks Runtime 19: November 16, 2026
items.text: Sections: Behavioral changes; Bug fixes. Starting with this release, new streaming queries in real-time mode use real-time watermark propagation by default. Stateful operators advance the event-time watermark within a batch, so late events are filtered against the live watermark and state is evicted sooner than before. Queries restarted from an existing checkpoint keep their original behavior. To keep the previous behavior for a new query, set spark.databricks.streaming.realTimeMode.realTimeWatermark.enabled to false before starting it. Operating system security updates and miscellaneous fixes.

items.title: Budgets now support daily thresholds in addition to monthly thresholds
items.text: Budgets scoped to Unity Gateway, including budgets for Genie, now support daily per-user thresholds in addition to monthly per-user thresholds. You can set a daily threshold, a monthly threshold, or both, and configure separate alert, webhook, and block usage actions for each period. Daily thresholds reset at 00:00 UTC. See Create and monitor budgets.
